negative_snippets:
Worst experience
I stayed at this hotel and it was a complete disappointment. The room was dirty, walls stained, lock broken, and door handle damaged — making me feel unsafe.
I ordered pasta and Hakka noodles; the pasta was cold, tasteless, and not fresh, and the noodles weren’t much better.
A total waste of money. I would never recommend this place to anyone.
